item.description:
# BetterFriend 0.6.1
- Adds the signed in-app update path and private feedback workflow. - Reworks first-run setup, Privacy & Data, Start at Login, and full local reset. - Replaces automatic plaintext profile sync with manual encrypted preference transfer. - Improves first-day recommendations, automatic Tracks, and draft choices. - Simplifies the dashboard toolbar and strengthens privacy and recovery checks.
BetterFriend still never sends messages for you. Relationship data and message content are never attached to update checks.
